title: DynSTEER: Dynamic Stage-wise Trajectory Evaluation and Execution-time Review for Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.14637v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed for long-horizon task execution. However, current evaluation paradigms face three major limitations: terminal-only assessment ignores intermediate processes and struggles to localize errors efficiently and accurately, single-reference matching penalizes valid alternative solution paths, and post-hoc trajectory judging incurs high costs without the ability to halt failed runs early. To address these issues, we propose DynSTEER, a dynamic stage-wise trajectory evaluation framework for agents. DynSTEER segments rollouts into stages anchored by key completed actions, focusing evaluation on essential milestones with adequate context while enabling targeted strategy adjustments. It compiles a path-tolerant milestone graph from public task views to respect diverse legitimate strategies without leaking ground truth. Furthermore, it adaptively routes evaluation queries across multi-tier judges

translated_title: DynSTEER：面向智能体的动态分阶段轨迹评估与执行时审查
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地被部署用于长时程任务执行。然而，当前的评估范式面临三大局限：仅基于终态的评估忽略了中间过程，且难以高效准确地定位错误；单一参考匹配会惩罚有效的替代解决方案路径；事后轨迹评判成本高昂，且无法及早终止失败的运行。为解决这些问题，我们提出了DynSTEER，一个面向智能体的动态分阶段轨迹评估框架。DynSTEER以关键已完成动作为锚点将轨迹回放分割为多个阶段，将评估聚焦于具有充分上下文的关键里程碑，同时支持有针对性的策略调整。它从公开的任务视图中编译出一个路径容错的里程碑图，在不泄露标准答案的前提下尊重多样化的合法策略。此外，它还能在多层级评判者之间自适应地路由评估查询。
tldr: DynSTEER提出了一个动态分阶段轨迹评估框架，通过基于关键动作锚点的阶段划分、路径容错的里程碑图以及跨多层级评判者的自适应查询路由，解决了现有智能体评估中仅看终态、单参考匹配和事后评判成本高且无法及早终止失败运行的三大局限。
en_tdlr: DynSTEER proposes a dynamic stage-wise trajectory evaluation framework that overcomes terminal-only assessment, single-reference matching bias, and costly post-hoc judging through stage segmentation anchored by key actions, path-tolerant milestone graphs, and adaptive multi-tier judge routing.
